hero.name: Gyn Nguyen
hero.tagline: Bridging business visions and software architecture with airtight requirements, BPMN 2.0 flows, and data modeling.

about.overviewContent: Overview of competencies, methodologies, and achievements.
about.professionalIntroContent: A dedicated Business Analyst with a strong engineering foundation in C#, .NET, and SQL databases. Specializing in translating complex stakeholder visions into airtight business requirements (BRD/PRD), optimizing end-to-end workflows (BPMN 2.0), and collaborating seamlessly with cross-functional development squads to deliver high-impact enterprise solutions.
about.name: Gyn Nguyen
about.visionContent_1: Requirements Engineering & Business Process Optimization: Experienced in eliciting, structuring, and validating business requirements from diverse stakeholders. Proficient in crafting comprehensive Business Requirements Documents (BRD), Product Requirements Documents (PRD), User Stories with Acceptance Criteria (Gherkin/BDD), and modeling clear As-Is / To-Be business processes using BPMN 2.0.
about.visionContent_2: Technical Foundation & Data Modeling (The Competitive Edge): Leveraged over 4 years of software development (.NET, SQL Server, MySQL, RESTful APIs) to evaluate technical feasibility early, design normalized entity-relationship schemas (ERD), write analytical SQL queries (PIVOT, Stored Procedures), and define unambiguous API contracts with engineering squads.
about.visionContent_3: Long-term Objectives: Drive digital transformation by championing agile methodologies, reducing delivery risks, eliminating requirements churn, and architecting robust digital solutions that maximize operational efficiency and enterprise value.

experience.experienceSummaryContent: Proven track record bridging business stakeholders, product managers, and engineering teams to deliver mission-critical software, enterprise portals, and high-concurrency systems.

hd.title: Technical Business Analyst & Systems Developer
hd.achievement1: Led requirement elicitation workshops with key business stakeholders; formulated BRD, PRD, and BPMN 2.0 workflows for internal operations and enterprise client projects.
hd.achievement2: Defined system architecture, API contracts (OpenAPI/Swagger), and database schemas for centralized enterprise management platforms.
hd.achievement3: Coordinated cross-functional teams, standardized IT operating procedures, and conducted User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure deliverable alignment with business goals.
hd.achievement4: Delivered production systems including automated audit tools (.NET 8), promotional applications, and real-time visitor check-in solutions.
hd.achievement5: Facilitated UI/UX ideation and wireframing in Figma, ensuring design system compliance and seamless developer handoff.

acacy.title: Systems & Data Analyst / .NET Developer
acacy.achievement1: Analyzed complex operational data requirements and engineered high-performance SQL queries and stored procedures for reporting and analytics.
acacy.achievement2: Utilized advanced SQL PIVOT techniques to transform raw transactional data into actionable business intelligence dashboards.
acacy.achievement3: Collaborated with product owners to draft API specifications and implemented backend services using .NET 8 and Dapper ORM.
acacy.achievement4: Participated in agile ceremonies, sprint backlog refinement, and acceptance criteria verification.

xteam.title: Systems Analyst & Platform Administrator
xteam.achievement1: Architected, tuned, and monitored multi-server real-time infrastructure supporting 2,000+ concurrent active users with 99.9% uptime.
xteam.achievement2: Analyzed system performance bottlenecks, telemetry logs, and implemented automated security and moderation mechanisms.
xteam.achievement3: Coordinated cross-partner integrations with external gaming and tech brands, defining workflow specifications and SLA metrics.

project1.name: Interactive Portfolio & System Showcase
project1.description: Engineered a high-performance portfolio featuring interactive 3D WebGL, GSAP micro-animations, and an interactive BA Workbench illustrating real-world business flows and API contract validation.

project2.name: Mobile Store Operations & Inventory System
project2.description: Analyzed business retail workflows, designed a normalized relational database schema (3NF) in SQL Server, and delivered an intuitive inventory and sales transaction platform.

project3.name: TunaApp High-Throughput Socket Engine
project3.description: Authored low-level communication protocol specifications; implemented a 3-stream multi-threaded TCP architecture in .NET 8 for low-latency authentication, presence, and chat.

project4.name: HDC Enterprise Operations & Web Services
project4.description: Conducted stakeholder discovery sessions, translated business operations into API specs, and developed secure RESTful services integrated with centralized audit workflows.

project5.name: Digital Campaign & Lead Conversion Portal
project5.description: Mapped customer acquisition journeys, structured data capture pipelines, and optimized web performance and SEO for enterprise promotional campaigns.
